belief_statement: One possibility is that architecture collaboration environmental psychology has inconsistent effects on cognitive performance, but the evidence is limited (2 findings, 2 studies). Further research is needed.

mechanisms.pathway: soft_fascination → involuntary attention → directed attention recovery
natural_stimuli → parasympathetic activation → cortisol reduction → stress relief

latent_variables.name: Individual sensitivity differences
latent_variables.rationale: High heterogeneity (high) across findings suggests an unmeasured individual-difference variable moderates the effect of architecture collaboration environmental psychology on cognitive performance.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Pre-screening for trait sensitivity or prior exposure

latent_variables.name: Cultural background
latent_variables.rationale: Individual/cultural differences theory is implicated. Cultural norms around nature, noise, or space may moderate effects.

latent_variables.name: Mechanism selection
latent_variables.rationale: Multiple mechanisms are implicated (Individual/Cultural Differences, Psychophysics / Perception, Attention Restoration Theory (Kaplan)). A latent variable may determine which pathway is activated.

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of architecture collaboration environmental psychology, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of architecture collaboration environmental psychology on cognitive performance replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is low. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.

research_needs.question: What moderates the effect of architecture collaboration environmental psychology on cognitive performance?
research_needs.rationale: High heterogeneity suggests an unmeasured moderator.

research_needs.question: Which mechanism best explains architecture collaboration environmental psychology → cognitive performance?
research_needs.rationale: 4 candidate mechanisms exist. Process tracing would identify the active pathway.

research_needs.question: What is the dose-response curve for architecture collaboration environmental psychology effects on cognitive performance?
research_needs.rationale: Dose-response data enables design guidelines with specific thresholds.
